settings.title: The Grip Sock Era Is Over
settings.body: We didn't set out to make a better grip sock. We set out to make grip socks unnecessary. One pair of Performance Skins replaces every grip sock you'll ever buy.

settings.title: Redefining Grip
settings.intro_text:
Barreletics is replacing the grip sock category with Performance Skins — injection-molded grippy shoes engineered for barre, reformer, Lagree, and Pilates.

Instead of asking 'which grip sock?' we want you asking 'why grip socks at all?' One pair. 360° grip. Done.
settings.manifesto: We didn't improve the grip sock. We made it obsolete.
settings.made_in_usa_heading: Designed and Made in the USA
settings.made_in_usa_text: Every pair of Barreletics is manufactured in the United States. From material sourcing to injection molding to quality control — the entire process stays domestic. No overseas factories. No compromises on quality oversight.

settings.title: Performance Over Promise
settings.description: Every claim we make is backed by the product itself. Injection-molded grip that never peels. Materials that never absorb. Results you can feel from day one.

settings.title: Category Creation
settings.description: We're not competing in the grip sock market — we're replacing it. Performance Skins are a new category of studio footwear built from first principles.

settings.title: Durability as Design
settings.description: Products should outlast the hype cycle. Many customers report 3-4 years of daily use. One purchase replaces years of disposable socks.

settings.title: Commitment Match
settings.description: You show up 6 days a week. Your gear should match that commitment. Built for people who take their practice seriously.

settings.title: Studio-First
settings.description: Designed for the demands of real studio environments — reformer carriages, Megaformer platforms, barre floors. Every detail serves the practice.

settings.title: Built by Someone Who Gets It
settings.body: Born from firsthand studio experience and frustration with grip socks that fail mid-class. Barreletics exists because the category needed disruption, not iteration.

settings.question: Barreletics — the story behind the brand
settings.answer: Founded in the USA, Barreletics creates performance footwear for barre, reformer, Lagree, and Pilates practitioners. Our patented injection-molded grip technology replaces traditional grip socks with a single durable solution.

settings.question: Why studios choose Barreletics over grip socks
settings.answer: Studios nationwide are recommending Barreletics to their clients. One pair replaces months of disposable grip socks, offering better grip, better hygiene, and better value long-term.

settings.title: 10% off your first pair.
settings.body: New drops, studio stories, and category updates. Once or twice a quarter.
